# lumos_app_entitlements (Data Source)

One app's entitlements, optionally filtered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "app_id" {
  type = string
}

# One app's entitlements that are listed in the App Store.
data "lumos_app_entitlements" "requestable" {
  app_id              = var.app_id
  visible_in_appstore = true
}

output "requestable_labels" {
  value = [for e in data.lumos_app_entitlements.requestable.entitlements : e.label]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The app's ID, which `GET /v1/apps` returns as `id`.

### Optional

- `search` (String) Case-insensitive substring match against the entitlement's label. Resend it with each `page_token`.
- `visible_in_appstore` (Boolean) Filter by App Store catalog visibility. When present, only entitlements configured in the App Store catalog are considered: `true` returns those visible in the catalog, `false` those hidden from it. Entitlements that aren't configured in the App Store catalog at all are excluded either way. Omit this filter to return every entitlement on the app regardless of App Store configuration. Requires permission to read App Store item settings.

### Read-Only

- `entitlements` (Attributes List) The app's entitlements. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements))

<a id="nestedatt--entitlements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entitlements`

Read-Only:

- `app_id` (String) The ID of the app that owns this entitlement.
- `approval_workflow_override` (Attributes) The entitlement's approval workflow override. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=approval_workflow_override for the full workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements--approval_workflow_override))
- `appstore_settings` (Attributes) The entitlement's App Store-catalog settings. Null unless expanded with expand=appstore_settings. Omitted entirely (not present, not null) when the parent app isn't enrolled in the App Store. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements--appstore_settings))
- `custom_approval_message_override` (String) This entitlement's own custom approval message, shown to requesters when the entitlement is approved, overriding the app's. Null means this entitlement inherits the app's approval message.
- `deprovisioning_workflow` (Attributes) The entitlement's deprovisioning workflow. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=deprovisioning_workflow for the full workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements--deprovisioning_workflow))
- `description` (String) Optional long-form description of the entitlement.
- `entitlement_type_label` (String) Human-readable label for the entitlement's type (e.g. 'Role', 'License', 'Group').
- `id` (String) The ID of this entitlement.
- `label` (String) Human-readable label for the entitlement (e.g. a role or permission name).
- `provisioning_workflow` (Attributes) The entitlement's provisioning workflow. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=provisioning_workflow for the full workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements--provisioning_workflow))
- `source` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--entitlements--approval_workflow_override"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entitlements.approval_workflow_override`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the bound workflow.


<a id="nestedatt--entitlements--appstore_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entitlements.appstore_settings`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_requester_groups_override` (Attributes List) Groups whose members may request this entitlement, overriding the app's allowed requester groups. Null means this entitlement inherits the app's allowed requester groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements--appstore_settings--allowed_requester_groups_override))
- `request_validation_webhook` (Attributes) The inline webhook called to validate access requests for this entitlement. This is configured directly on the entitlement; null means no webhook is configured (there is no inheritance from the app). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements--appstore_settings--request_validation_webhook))
- `time_based_access_override` (Attributes) This entitlement's own time-based access options. Null means this entitlement inherits the app's time-based access options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements--appstore_settings--time_based_access_override))
- `visible_in_appstore` (Boolean) Whether this entitlement is visible in the App Store catalog.
